metas.name: True Blood
metas.description: Thanks to a Japanese scientist's invention of synthetic blood, vampires have progressed overnight from legendary monsters to fellow citizens. And while humans have been safely removed from the menu, many remain apprehensive about these creatures "coming out of the coffin." Religious leaders, government officials, and vampire fundamentalists around the world have chosen their sides.  But in the small Louisiana town of Bon Temps, the jury is still out.

videos.title: Don't You Feel Me
videos.overview: Sookie escapes to a Fae land where Bill cannot influence her. Bill decides to seek Lillith's advice. Eric, Pam, Nora, Jason and Jessica are in danger.

videos.title: In the Evening
videos.overview: Eric pledges loyalty to Bill as a last resort to save Nora. A tragedy close to home forces Sam to ignore the warnings of Alcide and return to Bon Temps. Jessica shows her gratitude to James, a prisoner.

videos.title: Dead Meat
videos.overview: Sookie faces a major dilemma in deciding whether to broker a deal between Warlow and Bill. Over in vamp camp, Jason gets to know Violet, while Sarah goes to extremes to keep Tru Blood flowing. Alcide makes a decision that will impact the futures of Nicole and Sam.

videos.title: Life Matters
videos.overview: A desperate Bill tries to ferry Warlow away from the faerie plain, but Sookie is having none of it. Meanwhile, Eric arrives at vamp camp, looking to inflict serious human damage. In Bon Temps, friends and family take emotional turns remembering a fallen neighbor. Bill feels the pull of Lilith’s sirens.

videos.title: Radioactive
videos.overview: Jason feels a vampire attraction firsthand; and Bill finds that salvation isn't free. Meanwhile, Sookie considers her future with Warlow as a new crisis poses a threat to humans and vampires alike.

videos.title: Jesus Gonna Be Here
videos.overview: A band of rogue H-vamps crashes the vampire-human mixer at Bellefleur’s, with shocking results. As Sookie seeks refuge from accusations that she’s somehow to blame for the chaos in Bon Temps, the “one vampire for every human” plan moves forward. In the face of a vigilante insurrection led by redneck Vince, Bill receives aid from an unexpected source.

videos.title: I Found You
videos.overview: A trio of hostages taken in the Bellefleur’s attack looks to a familiar face as a possible liberator from the H-vamps. Sookie and Jason visit the neighboring town of Saint Alice, where a young woman’s diary offers clues to the potential fate of Bon Temps. Spurned by Lafayette, a desperate Lettie Mae turns to Willa to channel her family past. Vince whips his fellow vigilantes into a dangerous frenzy. Pam’s search for her maker leads her to a very familiar place.

videos.title: Fire in the Hole
videos.overview: Sookie hatches a dangerous plan to take down the H-Vamps, even as Vince and his armed vigilantes pose an equally serious threat. Lafayette gets high with James; Jason eyes a family future with Violet; Willa is forced to find a new place to stay; Sarah Newlin sheds her past. Pam offers Eric a compelling reason to return to Louisiana – and be the vampire he used to be.

videos.title: Death is Not the End
videos.overview: In the aftermath of yet another bloodbath, Sam, Sookie and Jason find themselves the bearers of bad news in Bon Temps and beyond. Pam recalls the events that led her and Eric to Shreveport and Fangtasia. Bill and Jessica get nourishment from unexpected sources. Following a new lead, Sookie enlists a band of vampires and humans to track down the H-Vamps.

videos.title: Lost Cause
videos.overview: Exhausted from her recent travails, Sookie finds herself the unwilling host of a festive mainstreaming party in Bon Temps. In search of an elusive adversary, Eric and Pam head to Dallas and attend a gala fundraiser. Andy makes a life-changing decision; Jessica and James reach a crossroads; Bill loses himself in remembrance of human days.

videos.title: Karma
videos.overview: Eric and Pam find a new ally in their search for a common enemy; Sookie makes a startling discovery that forces her to rethink her recent involvement with Bill; Lafayette shares a vision with Lettie Mae; Jason realizes how he really feels about Violet; Sam isn't sure what to do about Nicole.

videos.title: May Be the Last Time
videos.overview: Sookie looks for a miracle; Eric and Pam zero in on Sarah Newlin; Adilyn and Wade seek protection from Violet.

videos.title: Almost Home
videos.overview: Eric mulls his options; Sookie puts her life on the line for Bill; Lettie Mae finds closure; Violet has revenge on her mind.

videos.overview: Sookie weighs a future with and without Bill. Eric and Pam struggle with their uncomfortable partnership with Mr. Gus. Sam makes a choice, while Andy comes upon an unexpected inheritance. Series Finale.

metas.description: In a medieval kingdom where magic is punishable by death, young sorcerer Merlin, manservant to Prince Arthur and ward of the court physician, meets a dragon and finds he is a part of a great prophecy to bring about the golden age ...
metas.name: Merlin

videos.name: A Herald of the New Age
videos.overview:
The Camelot Knights stumble across an eerie shrine deep in the forest, its chilling atmosphere betraying a dark history best left undisturbed, as the magical drama continues.

But when Elyan ignores Merlin's warning, his actions spark a chain of events more frightening than anyone could possibly have imagined... Can a grievous wrong be put right? Or will past demons change the future forever?

videos.name: The Hunter's Heart
videos.overview: Morgana ends up discovering a powerful ally in the Southron warlord Helios and they come up with the perfect plan to bring Camelot to its knees. With Arthur preoccupied by the beautiful Princess Mithian, it ends up falling to an absent friend to raise the alarm.

videos.name: The Sword in the Stone (1)
videos.overview: Morgana is now the head of a vast Southron army and a deadly net is closing around Camelot. After the sorceress strikes everyone is forced to run for their lives including Arthur. It is down to Merlin to try and save Arthur from Morgana's clutches.
videos.description: Morgana is now the head of a vast Southron army and a deadly net is closing around Camelot. After the sorceress strikes everyone is forced to run for their lives including Arthur. It is down to Merlin to try and save Arthur from Morgana's clutches.

videos.name: The Sword in the Stone (2)
videos.overview:
Morgana and Helios have successfully captured Camelot, and Merlin and Arthur are outlaws on the run, in the last episode in this season of Merlin.

Trapped in Ealdor with a ruthless army closing in, their situation becomes desperate. Arthur must take control before Camelot is lost forever…

But faced with Agravaine’s betrayal and the strength of Morgana’s force, the young King has lost his conviction.

Only Merlin can restore his faith, and only an extraordinary act can prove to the King that he was born to rule.

Will the young warlock convince Arthur before his dreams of Albion fall to pieces?

videos.name: Arthur's Bane (1)
videos.overview: Camelot faces a new golden age, but even as the city flowers, the dark seeds of destruction are being sown. In the frozen wastelands of the north, men are disappearing without a trace. King Arthur and his knights undertake a dangerous mission into the unknown in search of answers - but once there, Merlin finds himself locked in a battle unlike any he has fought before.

videos.name: Arthur's Bane (2)
videos.overview: As dawn breaks across the icy tundra, Merlin and Arthur are close to exhaustion. With each tortured step, the fortress of Ismere looms ever nearer and Merlin's fear intensifies. What game is Mordred playing? And what powerful secrets are Morgana and the druid Ruadan (Liam Cunningham) searching for amongst its twisted catacombs? It seems like this time, not even Merlin can stop Arthur from walking right into the lion's den… For in this bleak and transient wilderness, only one thing is certain: the great trial for Albion has finally begun.

videos.name: The Death Song of Uther Pendragon
videos.overview:
When a stranger gives Arthur the power to summon the dead, the king finds himself torn between head and heart.

Unable to resist temptation, he seizes the chance to speak to the person he misses most – his father, Uther Pendragon. But the spirit world is a dark and dangerous place, for little does Arthur realize that his decision comes at a terrible price. Against all odds, Merlin must put right Arthur's mistake before Camelot, and everything they have built, is destroyed forever.

videos.name: Another's Sorrow
videos.overview: With Princess Mithian as the perfect bait, Morgana conjures a deception so powerful that the whole of Camelot is taken in - even Merlin himself. But as the storm clouds gather, will the young warlock see through the lies? Or will Morgana at long last fulfil her dreams of revenge?

videos.name: The Disir
videos.overview:
In the inky depths of an ancient pool, three soothsayers cast a dark judgment upon the King of Camelot.

But despite Merlin’s warnings, headstrong Arthur refuses to take the words of the Disir seriously and their fury rains down on Camelot. Only the greatest sacrifice can appease them, and with the kingdom in jeopardy, is it one that Arthur is prepared to make?

Faced with the King’s uncertainty, Merlin has just one chance to save him from his destiny, but this decision comes at the highest price.

videos.name: The Dark Tower
videos.overview:
When Gwen is snatched from Camelot without warning, Merlin knows there can be only one person responsible: Morgana. Arthur is determined to rescue his Queen – but it's not going to be easy, for she is locked in the Dark Tower, a place that haunts the dreams of men.

Arthur and his Knights must embark on a quest like no other, battling through a landscape riddled with hidden dangers, perilous obstacles and magical beings. As they near their goal, Merlin's sense of dread reaches breaking point. What twisted game is Morgana playing? And more importantly, just what is the final test that awaits them in the tower?

But when stable hand Tyr Seward becomes caught in the crossfire, he threatens to ruin everything… As the plot thickens and reaches its deadly climax, can a suspicious Merlin unravel the truth before it’s too late?

When Merlin agrees to help a young Druid boy, he has no choice but to leave Camelot on a dangerous mission.

And with the citadel distracted by the visit of the fearsome Sarrum of Amata, it seems that no one will notice his absence.

But as the sky darkens, so do Merlin's suspicions - is there more to Daegal than meets the eye? And can a man as ruthless as the Sarrum ever really be trusted? Too late, the young warlock realises he's made a terrible mistake.

Meanwhile, he poses as Yoon Dong-jin, a musical genius, and gets the attention of I-chan to join his band.

videos.name: I'm from a world you can't even imagine.
videos.overview: Eun-gyeol encounters Se-gyeong in her teens and learns a few things about her life that don't make sense in the future. Meanwhile, I-chan meets Chung-a for the first time, but she doesn't say a word. I-chan tries to get away from Eun-gyeol, but Eun-gyeol follows him to the Snail Guesthouse and ends up becoming I-chan's math tutor.

videos.name: The accident Dad mentioned hasn't happened yet.
videos.overview: Eun-gyeol resolves to stop the accident that caused I-chan to become deaf and clings to him, vowing to teach him everything he needs to know. He even promises to gift him the band I-chan needs. However, the school festival is in one month, and the person I-chan is doing this for has left the country and isn't going to return.

videos.name: Are you really the Choi Se-gyeong I know?
videos.overview: Everyone is confused at Se-gyeong's return, especially Eun-gyeol, who sternly warns her to stay away from I-chan. However, it doesn't work, and Se-gyeong approaches I-chan with different intentions. Meanwhile, Chung-a can only stand by and watch as she realizes she's lost her chance to tell I-chan how she feels.

videos.name: Ha Eun-gyeol, where are you?
videos.overview: Chung-a wakes up, realizing she's lying on a hospital bed, with the revelation that I-chan carried her there on his back. Later, I-chan learns her name from her tag for the first time. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol has been silent for days, causing concern for I-chan. Attempting to locate him, I-chan hands out flyers and ends up facing trouble with local thugs. Se-gyeong desperately meets with each band member to verify something important.

videos.name: Everything started changing the moment you arrived here.
videos.overview: Eun-gyeol wakes up at the house of the Jinsung Family after the accident. He finds out that Chung-a was the daughter of Chairman Yoon Gun-hyung. Meanwhile, I-chan is hospitalized after getting beat up by the local thugs. Se-gyeong tells him that Chung-a was the one who called for help to save him. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol decides to help Chung-a learn the sign language.

videos.name: Make a choice. Is it me or Choi Se-gyeong?
videos.overview: Astounded by Eun-gyeol's candid love confession for Se-gyeong, I-chan retaliates with a spirited punch. Eun-gyeol's attempts at self-defense lead to I-chan having a bleeding nose on both sides. The schoolyard transforms into a battleground as students try to intervene, and the entire situation gains momentum. Eun-yu is left in shock by the unexpected confession. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol uncovers a hidden secret about Chung-a.

videos.name: I want to learn sign language.
videos.overview: Eun-gyeol can't hide his feelings for Se-gyeong and ends up kissing her. Chung-a's stepmother calls Eun-gyeol separately and tells him to quit before he teaches Chung-a sign language. The members of band decide to change their band name and theme right before the festival and ask Se-gyeong and Chung-a for help. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol learns that Master has sent a helper for him.

videos.name: We resurrected as Watermelon Sugar.
videos.overview: As the festival draws near, the boys are intensely focused on fine-tuning their band performance. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol reflects on a pivotal clue related to a potential accident leading to hearing loss. Believing Dong-jin to be the helper that Master mentioned, he pleads with I-chan to skip the rehearsal, but his request is dismissed. Meanwhile, Eun-yu grapples with the challenge of uncovering her mother's genuine first love.

videos.name: If you are coming to the festival, choose me.
videos.overview: Eun-gyeol successfully cancels the rehearsal and prevents I-chan from getting seriously hurt. Chairman Yoon extends the contract with Eun-gyeol and changes the terms and conditions. The day of the festival is finally here, and Se-gyeong has to choose between Eun-gyeol and I-chan. Chung-a decides not to show up at the festival.

videos.name: It's not time yet. We can be together for now.
videos.overview: As the enchanting glow of their festival fades, Eun-gyeol and Eun-yu acknowledge the depth of their feelings, hoping for a lasting connection. Meanwhile, the anticipated disbandment takes an unexpected turn, giving the boys another shot at the stage. The hurdle now is creating their own song, and I-chan suggests a gathering for this endeavor while musing on how to persuade Chung-a to join.

videos.name: Are you two making a movie?
videos.overview: Eun-gyeol and Se-gyeong realize that they’re both time travelers. He learns that Se-gyeong also had a mission to accomplish while she was in 1995. Eun-gyeol finds out that Chung-a has been confined and abused for the past 12 years. Meanwhile, Se-gyeong tells Eun-gyeol that I-chan’s accident didn’t happen on the day before the festival and that it hasn’t happened yet.

videos.name: The real accident hasn't happened yet.
videos.overview: Eun-yu drops clues about I-chan's real hearing loss incident to Eun-gyeol. Knowing that Eun-gyeol tends to shoulder blame for everything, she pledges to support him through this tough time. However, suspicions linger in her mind about the complexity of her connection with Eun-gyeol. Together, they methodically investigate everyone linked to the accident in search of the truth. Meanwhile, I-chan assures Eun-gyeol that he won't leave the house for the entire day.

videos.name: Tomorrow is your only chance to go back.
videos.overview: I-chan gets hit by a car and loses his hearing. Master tells Eun-gyeol to go back to his time, but he refuses, determined to catch the guy who hit I-chan. Se-gyeong convinces Eun-gyeol to return to 2023, and when he finally does, a completely different life awaits him.
